browserCost: Browser projects always rerun: every select run of the CI web command (unit + browser) ran all 193 browser files (1544 in 8 runs), because @vitest/browser writes no per-file dependency record (seed record: project 'browser (chromium)' has 0 files). The no-op control reran 193/541 web files in 137 s, against 2 s for the unit-only no-op control. Most web mutations were measured with a separately seeded `--project unit` record (`web-unit`); browser files cannot be false negatives because they are always selected.
